label: 5.1 Angles
subgoals: Spin the terminal side from the fixed initial ray
Convert degrees to radians via pi/180
Add or subtract 360 deg for coterminal angles

label: Drawing Angles in Standard Position
subgoals: Anchor the vertex at the origin on the +x-axis
Divide the degree measure by 360 deg for the fraction turned
Mark positive for counterclockwise, negative for clockwise

label: Quadrantal Angles
subgoals: Spot terminal sides landing on an axis
Measure arc length s = r*theta and sector area (1/2)r^2*theta
